_publications._publicationTitle: Traditional and systems biology based drug discovery for the rare tumor syndrome neurofibromatosis type 2
_publications._context: Mouse Schwann cell line carrying floxed (non-deleted) Nf2 alleles (Nf2fl2/fl2), merlin-intact; part of the isogenic Nf2ex2-/- panel (MS01/MS02/MS03) in the Synodos NF2 consortium.

basicInfo.description: Mouse Schwann cell line with floxed but non-excised Nf2 alleles (Nf2fl2/fl2), merlin-intact; floxed-control counterpart to the Nf2ex2-/- lines in the Synodos NF2 consortium panel.
